__comment__: Verifies that files adhere to the rules defined in .editorconfig.
Used in pre-commit hooks and CI workflows.
__comment_Exclude: Patterns to exclude from EditorConfig checking (regex-based)
__comment_note1: Backslashes must be escaped in JSON strings (\. for literal dot)
__comment_note2: Common exclusions: build dirs, caches, generated files, third-party code
__comment_note3: Sphinx templates are excluded because they have specific formatting needs
